title: Who Moved My Cheese?
author: Spencer Johnson
opinion: I really enjoyed Who Moved My Cheese because it's simple but meaningful. The story teaches about how people react to change. It shows that being afraid to change can stop you from finding something better.
learned: I learned that change is a normal part of life, and we should not fear it. Instead, we should adapt quickly and move forward. If we keep waiting for things to stay the same, we might miss new chances for success or happiness.
